claim: testcontainers-modules 0.15.0 provides a feature-gated Mosquitto struct that starts an MQTT broker without authentication for use inside tests.
stance_target: a Rust integration-test harness for ha-linux-agent can spin a real MQTT broker hermetically
scope_conditions: testcontainers-modules 0.15.0, crate feature 'mosquitto', testcontainers ^0.27.0 dependency, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
quoted_support: Module to work with Mosquitto inside of tests. Starts a MQTT broker without authentication.

claim: The Image trait contract requires implementations to pin an immutable image tag rather than 'latest' to prevent test code randomly breaking when the underlying docker image changes.
stance_target: ha-linux-agent CI must pin an explicit eclipse-mosquitto image tag for reproducible tests
quoted_support: Implementations are encouraged to include a tag that will not change (i.e. NOT latest) in order to prevent test code from randomly breaking because the underlying docker suddenly changed.

claim: The Testcontainers Rust ImageExt builder exposes per-test configuration including startup timeout (default 60 seconds), ready-condition overrides, networks, mapped ports, mounts and health checks.
stance_target: the test harness can control broker readiness and networking precisely enough for reliable MQTT discovery tests
quoted_support: with_startup_timeout(self, timeout: Duration) — Sets the startup timeout for the container. The default is 60 seconds. ... with_ready_conditions(self, ready_conditions: Vec<WaitFor>) — Overrides ready conditions.

claim: The Mosquitto module supports both synchronous (SyncRunner) and async (AsyncRunner) container start, so it can be used from a tokio-based agent test suite.
stance_target: ha-linux-agent's async (tokio/rumqttc) code paths can be tested against a real broker
